layout.house_prompt: A hair salon with a salon floor, a waiting area, a storage room, and a bathroom. The salon floor has two salon chairs positioned in front of two mirrors on the wall, facing them. The waiting area has a sofa and a coffee table. The storage room has shelves with bottles. The bathroom has a toilet and a sink.

waiting_area.text_description: A modern minimalist hair salon waiting area in a bright neutral palette with a sofa and a coffee table.

vestibule.text_description: A modern minimalist compact vestibule/short hall transition space connecting the waiting area to the salon floor and providing discreet client access to the bathroom.

salon_floor.text_description: A modern minimalist hair salon floor in a bright neutral palette with two salon chairs positioned in front of two wall-mounted mirrors on the wall, facing the mirrors.

storage_room.text_description: A modern minimalist hair salon storage room with sturdy shelves stocked with bottles, a washable wall finish, and mechanical ventilation for product storage.

bathroom.text_description: A modern minimalist bathroom with a toilet and a sink.
